# Google Sans Flex

[日本語](README.ja.md)

The variable font Google Sans Flex, from `ofl/googlesansflex/` of [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts) at commit `06bfe0d62a98375cb09c942fa18e68bd32cff057`, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`). `TRADEMARKS.md`, `METADATA.pb` and `upstream_info.md` are the files of the same directory. lamina-ui is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google; "Google Sans Flex" names the original font here, as `TRADEMARKS.md` allows.

| File | Upstream name | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `GoogleSansFlex.ttf` | `GoogleSansFlex[ROND,opsz,slnt,wdth,wght].ttf` | 3 910 784 bytes |

The font is unchanged, byte for byte, and programs embed it unchanged (no subsetting or conversion); only the name is shortened, since brackets and commas are awkward in CMake paths. Its axes are `opsz` 1 to 144, `wdth` 25 to 151, `wght` 1 to 1000, `ROND` 0 to 100 and `slnt` -10 to 0 ([docs/resources.md](../../docs/resources.md)).
